gloss: right beside, directly to the side

definitions.gloss: right beside, directly to the side
definitions.explanation: Exactly beside something, directly to the left or right with no angle or offset. Emphasizes the precise lateral position.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}の{真横|まよこ}にコンビニがある。
examples.english: There's a convenience store right next to the station.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}が{真横|まよこ}から{飛|と}び{出|だ}してきて{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: I was startled when a car came flying out from directly beside me.

notes:
{真横|まよこ} uses the prefix {真|ま}〜 (true, exact) attached to {横|よこ} (side) to mean "directly beside" with no offset. It emphasizes precise lateral position.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {真横|まよこ}に{座|すわ}る: to sit right beside
- {真横|まよこ}に{立|た}つ: to stand right beside
- {真横|まよこ}から: from directly beside
- 〜の{真横|まよこ}: right next to ~

SIMILAR {真|ま}〜 COMPOUNDS:
- {真|ま}{前|まえ}: directly in front
- {真|ま}{後|うし}ろ: directly behind
- {真上|まうえ}: directly above
- {真下|ました}: directly below
- {真向|まむ}かい: directly opposite

All these compounds follow the same pattern: {真|ま} + directional word = "directly/exactly" in that direction.
